description.description: What this credential is and what it can do, in prose, for the sandbox that will present it without ever seeing it. Served to agents over the rules endpoint, so it must contain nothing secret — name the identity and its reach, never the value. An agent holding an opaque placeholder can send a request; only one told whose token it stands for can weigh whether to.

source.description: Exactly one source for the substituted value. secretRef is resolved in the proxy's configured credentials namespace (agentplane-egress-credentials), never this object's. authenticatedWorkloadToken is the bearer retained only after the proxy successfully authenticated the current sidecar request or CONNECT tunnel.

authenticatedWorkloadToken.description: Use this request or tunnel's already-authenticated workload bearer. The proxy never copies an unvalidated Proxy-Authorization header, and resolution fails when authenticated context is absent or no longer bound.

targets.description: Every exact location this credential may be presented in. A target fires only where a request actually presents the placeholder in that position, so declaring one does not make it apply to traffic that does not use it.

header.description: Request header the placeholder goes in, matched case-insensitively.

method.description: How the header value is parsed, and which whole component of that parse the placeholder must equal. wholeValue: the value itself. schemeToken: `<scheme> <credential>`. basicUsername and basicPassword: the halves of a `Basic base64(username:password)` payload. basicWhole: a `Basic` payload that is the credential entire, with or without a colon in it.

scheme.description: The scheme schemeToken expects, compared case-insensitively (`Bearer`). Meaningless for every other method.
